m: व्रत—पा mfn. upholding or observing religious ordinances or duties, RV.; VS.; Br.
व्रत—पारण, n. (Ragh.; Rājat. &c.) or व्रत—पार˚णा, f. (MW.) conclusion of a fast, the first eating or drinking after a fast.
व्रत—पक्ष m. du. (with प्रजा-पतेर्) N. of two Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.; Lāṭy.
N. of Agni, AV.; VS.; TS. &c.
व्रत—पत्नी f. mistress of religious obs˚ &c., Kauś.
व्रत—प्रदान n. the vessel wherein the Vrata-m˚ is presented, ŚrS.
the imposing of a vow, Pañcat.
व्रत—प्रद mfn. presenting the Vrata-milk, Br.; ŚrS.
व्रत—प्रतिष्ठा f. the performance of a voluntary religious act
